## AI assistance

## Checklist

- [ ] Links the primary source, not an aggregator or mirror
- [ ] The link resolves and uses current documentation or an explicitly identified version
- [ ] Annotation is original, one or two sentences, 60 words or fewer, and states a limitation
- [ ] No invented metrics, testing, dates or adoption claims
- [ ] Standard, proposal or vendor-specific status is labelled
- [ ] Placed alphabetically within the section
- [ ] Row added to research-evidence.md, or a maintainer has been asked to add it
- [ ] My original text is contributed under CC0 1.0; linked materials keep their own rights
